package composeconfig

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdateComposeConfigInput holds update data.
type UpdateComposeConfigInput struct {
	ID             string
	Title          *string
	Description    *string
	HasTitle       bool
	HasDescription bool
	Config         []byte
	HasConfig      bool
	TechIDs        []int
	HasTechs       bool
	Status         *int
	HasStatus      bool
}

// UpdateComposeConfig updates compose config and tech links.
type UpdateComposeConfig struct {
	ComposeConfigs     repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	ComposeConfigTechs repository.ComposeConfigTechRepository
	Tx                 repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle updates config.
func (uc UpdateComposeConfig) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateComposeConfigInput) (*domain.ComposeConfig, error) {
	if !in.HasConfig && !in.HasTechs && !in.HasTitle && !in.HasDescription && !in.HasStatus {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var cfg *domain.ComposeConfig
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		cfg, err = uc.ComposeConfigs.GetByID(ctx, in.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if in.HasConfig {
			cfg.Config = in.Config
		}
		if in.HasTitle {
			cfg.Title = in.Title
		}
		if in.HasDescription {
			cfg.Description = in.Description
		}
		if in.HasStatus && in.Status != nil {
			cfg.Status = *in.Status
		}
		if in.HasConfig || in.HasTitle || in.HasDescription || in.HasStatus {
			if err := uc.ComposeConfigs.Update(ctx, *cfg); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if in.HasTechs && uc.ComposeConfigTechs != nil {
			if err := uc.ComposeConfigTechs.Replace(ctx, in.ID, in.TechIDs); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return cfg, nil
}
